answer: Admission auction: each epoch sells 40 slots, so a sybil flood cannot wander in. Sealed bids decide entry: the 40th-highest bid is the clearing price, locked 20 epochs as a deposit. From a nebula of applicants, only the top 40 reach the oasis. 1,000 fakes at 60 POA cost 60,000 POA locked 20 epochs; misbehaving fakes forfeit their deposit. An honest agent pays 60 POA once, refunded after 20 epochs, so honest entry stays cheap and undiluted.
